title: src/components/<name>/meta.json
description: The facts of one component folder. scripts/build.mjs validates every meta.json against this schema (validateSchema(): type, enum, pattern, minimum, maximum, minLength, items, uniqueItems, properties, required, additionalProperties, propertyNames, anyOf and local $ref), then against the folder and its stylesheet (verifyComponents()). The keys are written in the order of "properties"; the optional ones may be left out.

name.description: The folder's name: lower-case words joined by -.

order.description: The cascade order of the stylesheet (src/index.css, ds.css, manifest.json "order"); unique.

docsOrder.description: The place of <name>.md in docs/components.md (unique), or null without <name>.md.

need.description: One line: the need this component answers (the "Which component for which need" table).

tier.description: plans/3.0.md: 1 ships with 3.0.0, 2 if time allows, 3 when its phase has room.

status.description: How settled the component's API is.

classes.description: Every ds- class the stylesheet owns, sorted; no other component lists one of them.

attributes.description: Every data- attribute its selectors name, sorted.

requires.description: The components a bundle pulls in with this one (sorted).

context.description: The components whose classes the stylesheet styles only where both meet (sorted); never pulled in.

hooks.description: Every documented hook (--ds-*) the stylesheet reads with a fallback, in the order of the docs/theming.md table. The component that owns a hook describes it ({ default, description }: one table row; adjacent hooks with the same default and description share a row); a component that only reads another's hook names that owner ({ owner }).

keyframes.description: The keyframes the stylesheet names, plus those <name>.keyframes.css defines (sorted).

keyframeDocs.description: One docs/motion.md keyframe table row per @keyframes of <name>.keyframes.css: what moves, and where it is used.

js.description: The JS modules (core or component) that drive this component's markup (sorted).

module.description: true when the folder holds <name>.js (its behaviour module, DS.<name>); leave it out otherwise.

progressive.description: The features newer than the floor that the stylesheet's "Progressive:" note names, in PROGRESSIVE_NAMES order.

ripple.description: Whether the component has a ripple host (rippleHosts, or a selector of RIPPLE_HOSTS that starts with one of its classes).

rippleHosts.description: The ripple host selectors this component adds to RIPPLE_HOSTS (src/js/ripple.js, generated block), in order. Each host also needs its pressed .ds-ripples rule, in its own stylesheet or in ripple.css.

roles.description: Colour roles the component asks for (conventions section 6); the integrator moves them into tokens.css and the themes.

labExempt.description: Motion Lab coverage exemptions (test/browser/lab.spec.js LAB_EXEMPT): a keyframe, motion class or DS.<module>.<function> that needs no demo, with the reason.

exceptions.description: Named exemptions of the guardrails of test/css.test.js that concern this component only, each key with its reason.

focus.description: A class (".ds-input") whose plain :focus selectors may draw the ring.

ripple.description: An action-like part (keyed by its class, or "input") that is no ripple host.

scroller.description: A block that scrolls without being positioned.

motionExceptions.description: Named exceptions of the motion rules (conventions section 8) for this component, each with its reason.

transition.description: Per property of the animate-list exceptions (rotate, width, height ...): the selectors that may transition it.

exitUnpaired.description: A movement exit (selector) that runs without ds-fade-out.

keyframeShape.description: A keyframe of <name>.keyframes.css that names both ends (or many stops).

press.description: A pressed selector (:active, .ds-pressed) that may scale.
